#Created so we can call on extracted steps and linear features and others can 
#run it more easily 

```{r setup}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(amt)
library(survival)
select <- dplyr::select
```

##1. Load extracted steps

```{r load}
west_path <- here("outputs", "ele_west_1hr_categ.rds")
ele_trk_extract_west <- readRDS(west_path)
nrow(ele_trk_extract_west)   # expect 3,690,049
```

## 2. Prep: unique strata, crossing indicators, land cover NAs

```{r prep}
lin_cols <- c("kaza_vet_fences_linear", "roads_linear", "hydrorivers_linear")
stopifnot(all(lin_cols %in% names(ele_trk_extract_west)))   

#checkpoints
head(ele_trk_extract_west$step_id_)                          #already "id_123"?
table(ele_trk_extract_west$season, useNA = "ifany")          #expect "wet"/"dry" only
sum(ele_trk_extract_west$sl_ <= 0, na.rm = TRUE)             #zero-length steps
colSums(is.na(ele_trk_extract_west[, c("grassland", "shrubland", "tree_cover")]))  #NAs to 0

# >>> NEW: only prefix step_id_ if it isn't already unique across elephants
already_prefixed <- all(str_starts(as.character(ele_trk_extract_west$step_id_),
                                   paste0(ele_trk_extract_west$id, "_")))

ele_trk_extract_west <- ele_trk_extract_west |>              # >>> CHANGED
  mutate(
    step_id_ = if (already_prefixed) step_id_ else paste(id, step_id_, sep = "_"),  # >>> CHANGED
    across(all_of(lin_cols), ~ if_else(is.infinite(.x) | is.na(.x), 0, .x)),
    fence_cross = as.integer(kaza_vet_fences_linear > 0),
    road_cross  = as.integer(roads_linear > 0),
    river_cross = as.integer(hydrorivers_linear > 0),
    across(c(grassland, shrubland, tree_cover), ~ replace_na(.x, 0))
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(sl_), sl_ > 0)                               # >>> NEW: log_sl_ must be finite

# >>> NEW: checkpoint, strata intact (each step_id_ has exactly 1 used step)
strata_check <- ele_trk_extract_west |> group_by(step_id_) |>
  summarise(n_case = sum(case_), n = n(), .groups = "drop")
table(strata_check$n_case)   # all 1s
summary(strata_check$n)      # mostly 11

# >>> NEW: checkpoint, enough used crossings per feature? (< ~30 → drop that term)
ele_trk_extract_west |> filter(case_) |> group_by(season) |>
  summarise(across(c(fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross), sum), n_used = n())

ele_trk_extract_west_wet <- ele_trk_extract_west |> filter(season == "wet")   # >>> CHANGED
ele_trk_extract_west_dry <- ele_trk_extract_west |> filter(season == "dry")   # >>> CHANGED

# >>> CHANGED: new name, guarded, list columns dropped (same as final Etosha version)
linecross_path <- here("outputs", "ele_trk_extract_west_linecross.rds")
if (!file.exists(linecross_path)) {
  ele_trk_extract_west |>
    select(-any_of(c("terrain_list", "linear_list"))) |>
    saveRDS(linecross_path)
}
```

## 3. Checks: crossing counts and overlap with distance-to terms

```{r checks}
check_crossings <- function(d) {
  list(
    counts = d |> group_by(case_) |>
      summarise(fence = sum(fence_cross), road = sum(road_cross), river = sum(river_cross)),
    cor = c(fence = cor(d$fence_dist, d$fence_cross, use = "complete.obs"),
            road  = cor(d$road_dist, d$road_cross, use = "complete.obs"),
            river = cor(d$water_rivers_dist, d$river_cross, use = "complete.obs"))
  )
}

check_crossings(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet)
check_crossings(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry)
```

## 4. Fit main SSF + step-length robustness check

Main model has no movement terms. The `slcheck` model adds `sl_` + `log_sl_` only to test
whether crossing coefficients are confounded with step length; it is not the reported model.
Note `sl_` is in degrees here (track built in EPSG:4326); fine for this comparison.

Fitting is slow (~3.5M rows per season), so fits are cached.

```{r fit}
fits_path <- here("outputs", "west_ssf_crossing_fits.rds")

# >>> CHANGED: river_cross removed (0 crossings in West with the current river layer)
f_main <- case_ ~ fence_dist + road_dist + water_rivers_dist +
  cropland_dist + grassland + shrubland + urban_dist + tree_cover +
  elevation + slope + aspect + evi + world_pop +
  fence_cross + road_cross + strata(step_id_)

f_slcheck <- update(f_main, . ~ . + sl_ + log_sl_)

# >>> NEW: one NA-filtered dataset per season, used by EVERY model below
model_vars <- c(all.vars(f_main), "sl_")
prep_model_dat <- function(d) d |> drop_na(all_of(model_vars)) |> mutate(log_sl_ = log(sl_))

west_model_dat <- list(wet = prep_model_dat(ele_trk_extract_west_wet),
                       dry = prep_model_dat(ele_trk_extract_west_dry))

# checkpoint: rows dropped by NA filter (should be 0 or very few)
c(wet = nrow(ele_trk_extract_west_wet) - nrow(west_model_dat$wet),
  dry = nrow(ele_trk_extract_west_dry) - nrow(west_model_dat$dry))

# >>> NEW: free memory, the linecross file is already saved
rm(ele_trk_extract_west, ele_trk_extract_west_wet, ele_trk_extract_west_dry); gc()

fit_season <- function(d) {
  list(main    = fit_clogit(d, f_main, model = FALSE),
       slcheck = fit_clogit(d, f_slcheck, model = FALSE))
}

if (file.exists(fits_path)) {
  west_fits <- readRDS(fits_path)
} else {
  west_fits <- map(west_model_dat, fit_season)
  saveRDS(west_fits, fits_path)
}

summary(west_fits$wet$main)
summary(west_fits$dry$main)
```

## 5. Robustness table

`shift_over_se` = change in crossing coefficient when step length is added, in units of the
main model's SE. |shift| < 1 SE = robust.

```{r robustness}
cross_terms <- c("fence_cross", "road_cross")   # >>> CHANGED

robustness <- map_dfr(names(west_fits), function(s) {
  m  <- summary(west_fits[[s]]$main)$coefficients[cross_terms, ]
  sc <- summary(west_fits[[s]]$slcheck)$coefficients[cross_terms, ]
  tibble(season = s, term = cross_terms,
         coef_main = m[, "coef"], se_main = m[, "se(coef)"],
         rel_sel_main = exp(m[, "coef"]),
         coef_sl = sc[, "coef"],
         shift_over_se = (sc[, "coef"] - m[, "coef"]) / m[, "se(coef)"])
})
robustness
```

##Steps 6: 

```{r aic}
compare_crossing <- function(data, label) {
  d <- data |>
    drop_na(fence_dist, road_dist, water_rivers_dist, cropland_dist, urban_dist,
            grassland, shrubland, tree_cover, elevation, slope, aspect, evi, world_pop,
            fence_cross, road_cross, river_cross)

  base  <- fit_clogit(d, update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_cross - road_cross - river_cross),
                      model = FALSE)
  cross <- fit_clogit(d, f_main, model = FALSE)

  tibble(season = label, model = c("base", "+ crossings"),
         AIC = c(AIC(base$model), AIC(cross$model)),
         BIC = c(BIC(base$model), BIC(cross$model))) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
}

aic_path <- here("outputs", "etosha_crossing_aic.rds")
if (file.exists(aic_path)) {
  crossing_aic <- readRDS(aic_path)
} else {
  crossing_aic <- bind_rows(compare_crossing(ele_trk_extract_etosha_wet, "Etosha wet"),
                            compare_crossing(ele_trk_extract_etosha_dry, "Etosha dry"))
  saveRDS(crossing_aic, aic_path)
}
crossing_aic
```


## 7. Three linear-feature scenarios

1. Distance-to only (`base` from section 6)
2. Distance-to + crossings (`main` from section 4)
3. Crossings replace distance-to for fences and roads (and rivers, via `river_cross`)

`water_rivers_dist` is kept in scenario 3 by default: it comes from the land-cover water
class (pans, waterholes), not the HydroRIVERS line layer, so it is mostly a water-access
habitat effect. Set `drop_water <- TRUE` to also drop it.

Only scenario 3 is fit here. Rows are filtered on the same variable set as section 6, so `n`
matches across all three scenarios and AIC is comparable.

```{r scenarios}
drop_water <- FALSE

f_base       <- update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_cross - road_cross)              # >>> CHANGED
f_cross_only <- update(f_main, . ~ . - fence_dist - road_dist)
if (drop_water) f_cross_only <- update(f_cross_only, . ~ . - water_rivers_dist)

# >>> CHANGED: base + cross-only fit once on the same rows, cached together
scen_path <- here("outputs", paste0("west_ssf_scenario_fits", if (drop_water) "_nowater", ".rds"))
if (file.exists(scen_path)) {
  scen_fits <- readRDS(scen_path)
} else {
  scen_fits <- map(west_model_dat, ~ list(
    base       = fit_clogit(.x, f_base, model = FALSE),
    cross_only = fit_clogit(.x, f_cross_only, model = FALSE)))
  saveRDS(scen_fits, scen_path)
}

scenario_table <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  mods <- list("1. distance-to only"              = scen_fits[[s]]$base$model,
               "2. distance-to + crossings"       = west_fits[[s]]$main$model,
               "3. crossings replace distance-to" = scen_fits[[s]]$cross_only$model)
  stopifnot(n_distinct(map_int(mods, "n")) == 1)    # same rows in all three
  tibble(season = s, scenario = names(mods),
         n   = map_int(mods, "n"),
         k   = map_int(mods, ~ length(coef(.x))),
         AIC = map_dbl(mods, AIC),
         BIC = map_dbl(mods, BIC)) |>
    mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC), dBIC = BIC - min(BIC))
})
scenario_table

# crossing coefficients with vs without the distance-to terms
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x, term = cross_terms,
  with_dist    = coef(west_fits[[.x]]$main$model)[cross_terms],
  without_dist = coef(scen_fits[[.x]]$cross_only$model)[cross_terms]))

# step-length check vs main (same rows, so AIC is comparable)
map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), ~ tibble(
  season = .x, model = c("SSF + crossings", "+ sl_ + log_sl_"),
  AIC = c(AIC(west_fits[[.x]]$main$model), AIC(west_fits[[.x]]$slcheck$model))) |>
  mutate(dAIC = AIC - min(AIC)))
```

#Step 8 

```{r coef-compare}
coef_compare <- map_dfr(c("wet", "dry"), function(s) {
  b  <- coef(scen_fits[[s]]$base$model)                 # >>> CHANGED: reuses section 6-7 fit
  m  <- coef(west_fits[[s]]$main$model)
  mv <- coef(west_fits[[s]]$slcheck$model)
  se <- sqrt(diag(vcov(west_fits[[s]]$main$model)))
  terms <- names(m)
  tibble(season = s, term = terms,
         base = b[terms], with_cross = m, with_move = mv[terms], se_main = se,
         shift_cross_se = (m - b[terms]) / se,
         shift_move_se  = (mv[terms] - m) / se)
})

coef_compare |> arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_cross_se)))
coef_compare |> arrange(season, desc(abs(shift_move_se)))

# >>> NEW: save summary tables for the cross-population comparison
saveRDS(list(scenario_table = scenario_table, robustness = robustness,
             coef_compare = coef_compare, note = "river_cross excluded: 0 crossings with gte5 layer"),
        here("outputs", "west_linear_summary.rds"))
```
